Volume 12, which takes the four bars (T-V12-54), runs every preview from M3b with no M5 exception: §3.15.12's head (V12 l. 2682) 'from M3b (§16) each look kind previewed … on B-CITY-lite's seeds of every rung', T-V12-54's milestone 'M3b (the previews); M-SF', W7's M3b cell, V12 §6's item-122 row. At M3b a correct build draws the `disaster` preview on no district, so `crisis.scale`'s second count ('every preview among them … whose units differ in number from the count §10.2 (c) gives that share of its place's units', registry l. 1208; §3.15.12's T122-5 bullet) fails it from M3b to M5, and no V12 milestone cell runs the district clauses at M5's exit, where §16 requires them.

issues.claim: Round 3 made §13.4's touch fallback a switchable default (VCS-r2-03, graded major): §13.4 (base l. 18640–18641) and V09 §4.12 — `AppPrefs.touch.editFabric` false on a coarse pointer hides T8 `fill`'s and T9 `shape`'s drags — and T126-1 now reads 'every tool of V09 §4.12's list completes its canvas script under touch, with `AppPrefs.touch.editFabric` on' (l. 18456), as T-V9-22 does. Volume 12 measures T126-1 without the setting: the registry row `layout.touch` (V12 l. 1214) 'the tools … whose canvas script fails to complete under touch events', §3.15.16's T126-1 bullet (l. 2807) and T-V12-59 ('`layout.touch` is 0 at 600 × 480'). Once the pre-decided fallback ships, T8's and T9's scripts cannot complete at the coarse-pointer default, so `layout.touch` fails a correct build that T126-1 and T-V9-22 pass.
issues.required_change: V12's registry row reads '… the tools of V09 §4.12's list whose canvas script fails to complete under touch events with `AppPrefs.touch.editFabric` on (V09 §4.12; §13.4's fallback changes only its default) …'; §3.15.16's bullet reads '**T126-1, every tool under touch at the medium class** — `layout.touch`: at 600 × 480 CSS px under coarse-pointer touch events, with `AppPrefs.touch.editFabric` on, each tool of V09 §4.12's list completes its canvas script …'; T-V12-59 adds 'with `AppPrefs.touch.editFabric` on' after '`layout.touch` is 0 at 600 × 480'.

issues.claim: DR44 now states the tier (R3-13; base l. 11981): a condition is `public` where its map row gives a look, `secret` where it is `none`, and §9.2's admission function admits a `public` row at every tier (l. 14697–14699) — 'a look-bearing condition is therefore never withheld at any key' (R3-13). The disaster's linked condition reads the `calamity` row, which gives `disaster` (V08 §3.16 (7) (b)), so it is `public`. T-V2-60 still stages the impossible key: (e) 'a viewer whose knowledge key withholds the condition sees the look on no building', and the clause round 3 added to (g) 'View as set to a key that withholds the condition, the struck buildings' damage marks re-emitted and the tile redrawn after each'. No fixture can supply that key; a key built to omit the condition finds the look drawn and (e) failing a correct build, or the condition is made withholdable against DR44 — the case R3-13 removed from T-V10-52 (VAH-r2-07, major).
issues.required_change: T-V2-60 (e) reads '(e) the disaster's condition, whose map row gives the look and so `public` (§7.7's DR44), draws the look on its units' buildings under View as at `public`, `local` and `secret` alike, and a `none`-row condition carried beside it (an infiltrated stressor) draws no look on any building at any key;'; (g)'s clause reads '… a preview started and ended, and View as changed, the struck buildings' damage marks re-emitted and the tile redrawn after each, the look standing at every key …'. V02 §3.18's edge row 'a condition the view's key withholds → no look' stays (the withheld condition being a `none`-row one).

issues.claim: As VAP-r3-03, at V03: T-V3-40 (b) (V03 l. 2899) 'each building of a returned district draws its damage at the look's `lookLevel` … and at its own level outside them, after the hand-over (`crisisLookYields`), with Show crises off and at a key that withholds the condition'. The disaster's condition is `public` (DR44; R3-13), so no key withholds it: the clause asks for a fixture that cannot exist, and a key built to omit the condition finds the look drawn and the clause failing a correct build.
issues.required_change: T-V3-40 (b) reads '… and at its own level outside them, after the hand-over (`crisisLookYields`) and with Show crises off; under View as at `public`, `local` and `secret` the same drawing, the condition `public` (§7.7's DR44); …'. V03 §5.6 (4)'s and (5)'s general sentences on a withheld condition stand (a `none`-row condition draws no look).

issues.claim: As VAP-r3-03, at V04, in the clause round 3 added: T-V4-82 (i) (V04 l. 3144) '… and at its own level with Show crises off, at a key that withholds the condition, in the weeks outside the condition's and from the week a Works begun on the church hands it over'. issues.required_change: T-V4-82 (i) reads '… and at its own level with Show crises off, in the weeks outside the condition's and from the week a Works begun on the church hands it over (V06 §3.22 (3)'s `crisisLookYields`; this clause once V06's E2 has landed); under View as at `public`, `local` and `secret` the same drawing, the condition `public` (§7.7's DR44); …'.
